reviewer: claude, from frames and the issue text

steps.action: Firefox Nightly for Android, homepage with the main menu open; the menu has a 'VPN' row with an On/Off toggle (On), and the signed-in account row
taps the VPN toggle repeatedly: Off, then On (00:04.2), Off, On (00:06.7)
closes the menu, opens the tab tray and the mullvad.net tab ('Privacy is for the people')
opens the site/trust panel from the address bar ('Firefox is on guard', Enhanced Tracking Protection, VPN row) and toggles VPN off and on several times (until about 00:20)
opens the page menu on mullvad.net (Back/Forward/Share/Refresh, VPN row, Bookmark page, Find in page, Desktop site) and toggles VPN off and on many times until the end (00:45)

actual: When the toggle goes from Off to On, the pill sometimes reads 'Connecting...' for a single video frame (about 25 ms at ~40 fps) and then 'On': at about 00:04.2 and 00:06.7 (homepage menu), 00:15.7 (trust panel), 00:27.8, 00:32.5 and 00:41.1 (page menu). It is not readable at normal viewing speed and is missed entirely at 4 fps sampling. On other Off -> On taps no 'Connecting' frame was found. While VPN is on, the mullvad.net page banner keeps saying it is not using Mullvad VPN (that is page content, not the toggle).
not_visible: the wait of a few seconds before tapping vs rapid taps (the user taps quickly in most cases; timing intent is not stated on screen)
the address-bar VPN badge intermediate state - not checked frame by frame
the sign-in to the built-in VPN (only an account row in the menu)
notes: 526x1170, no audio, variable frame rate ~40 fps. The 'Connecting...' frames were found by OCR over every native frame and checked visually; OCR may miss some, so the list of occurrences may be incomplete. Three menus look alike (homepage menu, trust panel, page menu).
